Intuitive Surgical Profit Rises 7%
Medical-device maker to retire $2 billion worth of stock under accelerated program
By Maria Armental
Jan. 24, 2017 at 4:43 pm ET
Intuitive Surgical Inc. ISRG 1.51% reported a double-digit revenue increase in the
most recent quarter while profit, up year over year, declined sequentially as the
medical device maker ramps up spending.
The Sunnyvale, Calif., company also said it had entered into an accelerated share-
buyback program with Goldman Sachs to retire $2 billion worth of stock. The
company has a market value of roughly $26 billion.
Shares, up 18% over the past 12 months, rose 2% to $680.94 in after-hours trading as
results largely beat projections.
Over all, fourth-quarter profit rose 7% to $204 million, or $5.13 a share. Excluding
stock-based compensation and other items, profit rose to $6.09 a share from $5.89 a
share a year earlier.
Revenue, as the company had previously reported, rose 12% to $756.9 million.
Gross profit margin improved to 69.7% from 67.8% a year earlier.
Operating costs rose 23% to $262.8 million.

Operationally, this was another very strong quarter. Management raised procedure-growth expectations to approximately **14.5%–16.5%** for 2018. Yet the supplied next-day return was slightly negative.
